title: ASC 974 – Real Estate–Real Estate Investment Trusts
summary: Addresses organizational costs, property acquisition costs, and non-GAAP Funds From Operations for real estate investment trusts.
description: ASC 974 clarifies that REIT status is fundamentally a tax concept rather than a distinct GAAP measurement model. It covers organizational and offering costs, property acquisition costs, and Funds From Operations as a non-GAAP supplemental metric reconciled from net income. No dedicated IFRS REIT standard exists.

bannerNotice.title: No Direct IFRS Equivalent
bannerNotice.body: No dedicated IFRS REIT standard exists. REIT qualification is fundamentally a tax concept in US GAAP, and no equivalent tax-driven structure exists under IFRS.
